timeline.event: East Polynesian voyagers settle Aotearoa by waka hourua
timeline.label: c. 1250–1300

timeline.event: Abel Tasman becomes the first European to sight New Zealand
James Cook's Endeavour makes landfall at Tūranganui-a-Kiwa (Gisborne)
Samuel Marsden preaches the first Christian sermon, at Oihi
Northern rangatira sign He Whakaputanga, a declaration of independence
The Treaty of Waitangi is first signed
Pōtatau Te Wherowhero becomes the first Māori King
Gold is found at Gabriel's Gully, starting the Otago gold rush
The seat of government moves from Auckland to Wellington
Mount Tarawera erupts, destroying the Pink and White Terraces
New Zealand women win the right to vote in national elections
New Zealand becomes a Dominion of the British Empire
ANZAC troops land at Gallipoli
The Hawke's Bay earthquake devastates Napier and Hastings
Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reach the summit of Everest
The Waitangi Tribunal is established
French agents sink the Rainbow Warrior in Auckland Harbour
Parliament passes the law making New Zealand nuclear-free
The first general election under MMP is held
The Return of the King sweeps the Academy Awards

places.name: Wellington
places.clue: The world's southernmost capital of a sovereign state, on the shores of Te Whanganui-a-Tara harbour.

places.name: Auckland
places.clue: New Zealand's largest city, Tāmaki Makaurau, sits on a narrow isthmus between two harbours.

places.name: Queenstown
places.clue: Commercial bungee jumping began nearby in 1988, at this Lake Wakatipu resort's Kawarau Bridge.

places.name: Aoraki / Mount Cook
places.clue: New Zealand's highest peak, 3,724 m, sacred to Ngāi Tahu as their most important ancestor.

places.name: Milford Sound / Piopiotahi
places.clue: A glacier-carved fiord in Fiordland where Mitre Peak rises straight from the water.

places.name: Rotorua
places.clue: A geothermal city of geysers and bubbling mud, and a heartland of Te Arawa culture.

places.name: Waitangi Treaty Grounds
places.clue: Where the Treaty of Waitangi was first signed on 6 February 1840, in the Bay of Islands.

places.name: Hobbiton Movie Set
places.clue: The Shire from The Lord of the Rings, built on a working sheep and beef farm near Matamata.

places.name: Napier
places.clue: Rebuilt after the 1931 Hawke's Bay earthquake, it is famed for its Art Deco streets.

places.name: Cape Reinga / Te Rerenga Wairua
places.clue: In Māori tradition, the leaping place of spirits departing for Hawaiki; its lighthouse overlooks two seas meeting.

places.name: Moeraki Boulders
places.clue: Huge spherical concretions scattered along Koekohe Beach on the North Otago coast.

places.name: Punakaiki Pancake Rocks
places.clue: Layered limestone stacks and blowholes on the wild West Coast in Paparoa National Park.
